method.build: release/default features/mimalloc; JDK 17.0.12; Apple M4 Pro; one thread
method.prepared_boundary: Released generated Java on prebuilt GenericRowData/BinaryRowData versus production Calc on matching Arrow. Production operation plus equal checksum timed inside Rust. JNI entry/import/export and both perimeter transposes outside the small-operation timer; previous intrinsic JVM computation stays inside.
method.previous: Actual independently compiled main encoder from base, required to bind a JVM evaluator. Candidate requires empty descriptors and nonempty intended native-function route.
method.signature: Matching nullable/NOT NULL declarations on both Arrow and Java; NULL every seven rows where selected.
method.order: Serial paired processes, 16 warmups, nine measurements, 131072 processed rows per trial; matching checksums retained.
method.pipeline: One million nullable INT rows; rowwise source/blackhole; parallelism one; two warmups/five measurements. Retains production JNI, planning/startup and both transposes; consumed native Calc work required, candidate requires empty descriptors.
method.allocation: Untimed production probe; CountingAllocator wraps System with link aliases malloc=mi_malloc/free=sf_free. Excludes JVM/C++/other-thread allocations. Timed counts disabled, wrapper check retained.
method.constant_null_controls: NULL positions fold only after the recursively verified integer operand proof excludes failures. These controls measure Calc result materialization and consumption, not executed function-kernel work; exclude them from bulk function qualification.
